title: 初一听对话判断：手工作品展
instruction: 听完整对话，判断四个陈述正误，选T（正确）或F（错误）。本机音轨内对话一遍，可自行重播；来源未规定统一重播次数，不当成考试只能听一次。
audio_introduction: Listen to the conversation. Nora, Tom and Liam are at a craft display. Read the four statements. Choose true or false.

clips.context: Nora, Tom and Liam are at a craft display.

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Me too. What do you like about them, Tom?

turns.speaker: T
turns.text: The small painted windows. Liam, do you like them?

turns.speaker: L
turns.text: Yes. I want to make one myself.

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Look at these paper kites. I do not like them very much. The strings fall off too easily.

turns.speaker: T
turns.text: I do like them. The children at this school made all the kites.

turns.speaker: L
turns.text: Can we look at the boats first, then come back here?

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Sure. The boats are by the big window.

questions.stem: All three children like the model boats.
questions.rationale: Tom说喜欢、Nora说Me too、Liam回答Yes并想自己做；F与三人的明确回应冲突。

questions.stem: Nora likes the paper kites very much.
questions.rationale: Nora明确do not like them very much；T与否定态度冲突。

questions.stem: The children at the school made the paper kites.
questions.rationale: Tom明确school children made all the kites；F与原句冲突，不推断模型船作者。

questions.stem: The children plan to look at the kites before the boats.
questions.rationale: Liam提出boats first then come back，Nora同意；T倒置行动次序。
